title: PH, Japan defense chiefs reject force to change Indo-Pacific status quo

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Defense officials of the Philippines and Japan have expressed their opposition to any attempts that would change the status quo in the East China Sea and South China Sea through force. This after Department of National Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. and Minister of Defense of Japan Koizumi Shinjiro held a defense ministerial meeting in the Philippines.
